sections.installation:
🚀 Unleash Unlimited Content Power in Under 5 Minutes:

  1. Install WooCommerce (if you haven’t already)
  2. Install RedFox Tab Manager – Download and activate through your WordPress admin
  3. Create Mind-Blowing Tabs – Use ANY Gutenberg block to add videos, galleries, forms, testimonials, pricing tables, and more!
  4. See the Magic – Visit any product page to see your interactive, engaging tabs in action
  5. Watch Sales Explode – Rich content converts visitors into customers like never before!
sections.faq:
Will this really increase my sales?

Absolutely! Rich, interactive content massively outperforms boring text. Video demos can increase conversions by 80%+, image galleries reduce returns, interactive forms capture leads, and testimonials build instant trust. When customers can see, interact, and engage with your products, they buy with confidence!

Do I need WooCommerce for this to work?

Yes! This plugin is specifically designed to supercharge your WooCommerce store. You’ll need WooCommerce installed first.

Can I really use ANY Gutenberg block?

YES! Every single WordPress block works, plus ANY third-party blocks from plugins you have installed. Video blocks, gallery blocks, form blocks, testimonial blocks, pricing table blocks, countdown timer blocks, map blocks, social media blocks – literally EVERYTHING! If it works in Gutenberg, it works in your product tabs.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes! RedFox Tab Manager works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme. It automatically matches your store’s styling for a seamless look.

Is it difficult to set up?

Not at all! If you can use the WordPress editor, you can create amazing tabs. It’s literally the same familiar Gutenberg interface you already know, just inside product tabs. Zero learning curve!

Can I add different tabs for different product types?

Currently, the plugin creates global tabs that appear on all products, ensuring consistency across your store. This actually helps with customer experience and conversion optimization.

What if I don’t like it?

We’re confident you’ll love the unlimited creative possibilities, but if you’re not 100% satisfied, simply deactivate the plugin. No harm done to your store.
